newsitem.title: UK: GUS, British Land plan joint venture- paper.
newsitem.headline: GUS, British Land plan joint venture- paper.

text.p: Britain's largest mail order group Great Universal Stores (GUS) is in talks aimed at injecting some of its key property assets into a joint venture with British Land, The Sunday Times newspaper reported.
The deal is intended to maximise the performance of GUS's extensive property interests, it reported.

The newspaper said analysts believe that the group's property assets have been under-exploited. It said Gus will inject assets into a joint company that will then be held off the balance sheet and be managed by British Land.
The company will be financed by debt allowing Gus the option of realising cash for reinvestment in higher yielding ventures, said the newspaper.
